hooks.command: r="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}")"; h="$r/scripts/harness/session_start.sh"; [ -f "$h" ] && bash "$h" || exit 0

r="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}")"; h="$r/scripts/harness/guard_bash.py"; if [ -f "$h" ]; then python3 -I "$h"; elif [ -d "$r/harness" ]; then printf '%s' "{\"hookSpecificOutput\": {\"hookEventName\": \"PreToolUse\", \"permissionDecision\": \"deny\", \"permissionDecisionReason\": \"harness guard script missing: scripts/harness/guard_bash.py is absent in this repository although harness/ exists, so destructive commands cannot be checked. Restore the script, or reload hooks with /hooks if you just merged.\"}}"; else exit 0; fi
r="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}")"; h="$r/scripts/harness/format_file.sh"; [ -f "$h" ] && bash "$h" || exit 0

r="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}")"; h="$r/scripts/harness/stop_gate.sh"; if [ -f "$h" ]; then bash "$h"; elif [ -d "$r/harness" ]; then echo "harness: scripts/harness/stop_gate.sh missing, verification gate skipped (run bash scripts/harness/check.sh manually)" >&2; exit 0; else exit 0; fi
